source.source_behavior: SetAmber delegates to SetTheme("amber"), which applies the browser theme and returns the selected value.

laravel_adaptation.shared_runtime: The Settings control uses the same aiwm-color-theme key and data-theme contract already consumed by the Laravel shell theme picker.

behavior.authoritative_read: The control initializes from the active document data-theme, falling back to the persisted aiwm-color-theme value and then gold.
behavior.apply: Selecting Amber sets data-theme=amber immediately and persists aiwm-color-theme=amber.
behavior.synchronization: A MutationObserver follows external data-theme changes made by the existing shell theme picker; a storage listener reconciles same-origin persisted changes.

authorization_and_tenant_isolation.authentication: Inherited from the authenticated tenant SPA bootstrap.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.permission: tenant.view or wildcard is required before the Settings appearance control renders.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.tenant_source: Server-authored FrontendContext supplies the active tenant; SetAmber accepts no tenant, site, user, or resource identifier.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.foreign_tenant: The existing generic Settings workspace tenant.context contract rejects cross-tenant /tenants/{tenant}/settings access with 404.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.csrf: not applicable because the operation performs no HTTP mutation
